WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count,
        AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_category_lines
    FROM category_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(category_stats.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(category_stats.line_count) AS avg_budget_lines,
    AVG(category_stats.line_count - averages.avg_category_lines) AS avg_lines_above_category_average
FROM category_stats
CROSS JOIN averages
WHERE category_stats.line_count > averages.avg_category_lines;
